requested_outcome: Repair the verified public-site defects, preserve working booking and discovery behavior, publish one tested candidate to the current temporary public VII destination, and verify it after publication.
authorization_boundary: Adir explicitly authorized public publication. Primary-domain DNS cutover, legal certification, real purchases, outbound messages, and destructive production data changes remain outside this release.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is a public customer release.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require exact-version post-deploy journeys, rollback and direct link.

lesson_bundle.reason: Search, sliders, cards, galleries and nearby location are interactive.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise success, failure, retry, reload and reset states.

lesson_bundle.reason: Reported defects include clipping, overlays and delayed media on mobile.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify 390px and low-height mobile paths independently.

lesson_bundle.reason: Online capability, managed pages, filters and nearby discovery are central.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require fast cached undated results, dated live reads and recoverable zero/error states.

lesson_bundle.reason: The audit found spacing, card, rail and room-layout defects.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require full-page visual review and no clipping, slivers or unexplained whitespace.

lesson_bundle.reason: The audit found missing, distorted and illustrative media concerns.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require valid media, correct crop, truthful identity and no broken image state.

lesson_bundle.reason: Broken managed pages and sitemap inventory affect public trust.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exclude invalid generated pages and verify canonical, robots and sitemap behavior on the temporary host.

lesson_bundle.reason: Public test data and publication guards originate in managed data.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require a durable exclusion guard without opening admin permissions.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A release is published while the public test listing is still visible.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Block test/demo inventory at the canonical public boundary and sitemap.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Exact public searches and homepage contain none of the known test identity fields.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Online booking or undated online filtering regresses.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve last-known-good cached capability behavior and run booking journeys before and after deploy.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Undated filter returns immediate cached results and a dated result reaches a valid booking action.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A local build passes but cards, rooms or sliders are still visibly broken.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inspect the rendered candidate at desktop and 390px before publication and again on the exact deployed version.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No broken media, cut rails, nested frames, card-only detail button, or mobile overlay blocks the tested families.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The release claims infrastructure, accessibility or legal completion without proof.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep those claims explicitly bounded and publish only verified product-code changes.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Release evidence distinguishes current routing indicators from unverified infrastructure and human legal/assistive-tech review.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A new version is published without a verified rollback.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Pin the current deployed version and verify rollback identity before deploy.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Release manifest names exact prior version and rollback method.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After focused source fixes and targeted tests for the five highest-risk families, before full build and sitewide expansion.
checks: Undated online capability remains last-known-good and fast
Nearby-location failure resolves quickly with manual recovery
Localized first viewport has no mixed Hebrew

attack_questions: Can the known test entity be reached by any public listing, search route or sitemap?
Can a supplier/API interruption erase cached online results?
Can mobile users become stuck behind location, map or slider controls?
Can a broken image, clipped first card or giant white room panel still appear?
Can any changed route regress booking, contact or WhatsApp behavior?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact version observed at https://vii.spaplus.co on desktop and 390px mobile after publication.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Every listed family maps to a passed check, precise blocker or justified exclusion.

effectiveness.baseline: Public version 531 at commit c7e2d47 has verified audit defects and restored booking behavior to preserve.
effectiveness.target: One bounded release candidate, zero repeated identical deploy attempts, no P0/P1 regression in the affected family.
